summary: Role successfully implements Mnemonic Protocol server with 5 trigger-point hooks for DAG attestation. All hooks follow idempotent patterns with proper error handling and `set -euo pipefail`. Variable scoping uses consistent `mnemonic_mcp_*` prefix. Molecule mocks MCP server realistically. Version pinned (v0.1.0 as placeholder). README documents trigger points and outage recovery. SystemD uses `LoadCredential` for signing key security.
